title: Mirabel and the Current
author: Felix Whitlock
blurb: Ada Thackeray, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
